title: Chrome 160 introduces breaking changes to WebMCP for AI agents
content:
X author: @PPCLAND

Developers working on WebMCP, a proposed standard for software agents to use site actions, are facing breaking changes in Chrome 160; a stable subset is targeted for early 2027.

Linked sources:
- https://ppc.land/googles-change-to-chromes-ai-agent-feature-breaks-early-testers-code/

novelty.reason: This is a new development regarding breaking changes to the WebMCP standard for AI agents introduced in Chrome 160, which has not been covered in any previously listed items.
